description: This file defines thread-safe buffer utility classes, specifically for multi-producer single-consumer scenarios with striped bounded buffers and supporting classes like BitOps and Padding. It implements classes for managing concurrent buffers, including methods for adding, draining, and clearing buffers, along with bit-twiddling utilities.

classes.name: StripedMpscBuffer`1
classes.description: Provides a thread-safe striped bounded buffer that scales with concurrent threads by using multiple underlying buffers and rehashing thread IDs for contention avoidance.

classes.name: MpscBoundedBuffer`1
classes.description: Implements a multi-producer, single-consumer ring buffer with lock-free add and remove operations, suitable for high-performance concurrent scenarios.

classes.name: BufferStatus
classes.description: Enum indicating the result status of buffer operations such as Success, Full, Empty, and Contended.

classes.name: BitOps
classes.description: Provides utility methods for bit manipulation, including power-of-two calculations and 64-bit hash mixing.

classes.name: Padding
classes.description: Defines cache line size constants used for padding to prevent false sharing in concurrent structs.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the striped buffer by summing counts of individual buffers.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the striped buffer based on the number of stripes and buffer size.

methods.name: DrainTo
methods.description: Transfers items from the buffer into an external array or span, returning the number of items transferred.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to add an item to the buffer, performing rehashing and contention handling.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the buffer, resetting all individual buffers.
